# Norn

> Norn is the coordination language for teams of people and AI agents. A Norn program asks, waits, decides and hands work over. Every request verb (ask, confirm, choose, run, judge) returns a request that the program waits on with ->wait; it ends in a reply (Answered, Refused, NoReply, Broke, Cancelled or Revoked), and the type checker makes the program handle each one and never drop a request. Status: a design draft with a local reference implementation (parser, type checker, durable evaluator, simulated host). No production host runs it yet.

The syntax is ReScript. Participants are values like `@alice`; a request's own deadline is `~by=1h` or a time, and `->waitUntil(1h)` stops only the wait; facts and streams come from the host. Check a program with `norn check --json file.norn`.

## Writing Norn

- [Skill: writing Norn](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/skills/norn/SKILL.md): the model, the built-ins, the checker's diagnostic codes and how to fix them, and six patterns
- [Examples](https://github.com/norn-lang/norn/tree/main/examples): a decision with a default, a follow-up with a handover, a release chain, a standing duty, and a "keep going until done" loop
- [Standard library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/std/std.norn): `remind`, `decide`, `followUp`, `schedule`, `routine` and `digest`, written in Norn
- [Reference host interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/hosts/reference.norn): the facts, streams and types that programs can use with the reference host

## Reference

- [Language spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/spec.md): what Norn is, its syntax, effects, standard library, safety rules, runtime protocol, and what changed from the first draft (§15)
- [Types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/types.md): inference, built-in signatures, exhaustiveness, the rule that requests and replies are never dropped, host interfaces and diagnostics
- [Syntax tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/ast.md): the AST and its versioned JSON form
- [Reference runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/reference-runtime.md): the ledger runtime, and how to run programs against the simulated team

## Optional

- [Runtime research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norn-lang/norn/main/docs/research/runtime.md): the durable-execution design behind the runtime
